# candidate: find 4-connected 8-region from 6; mark its cells touching grid edge or any 1 in 8-neighborhood
from collections import deque
reach={(0,0)}; q=deque([(0,0)])
while q:
 r,c=q.popleft()
 for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
  rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
  if 0<=rr<R and 0<=cc<C and grid[rr][cc]==8 and (rr,cc) not in reach:
   reach.add((rr,cc)); q.append((rr,cc))
region=[row[:] for row in grid]
for r,c in reach:
 boundary=(r==0 or c==0 or r==R-1 or c==C-1)
 near1=any(0<=r+dr<R and 0<=c+dc<C and grid[r+dr][c+dc]==1 for dr in (-1,0,1) for dc in (-1,0,1))
 if boundary or near1: region[r][c]=7
print('reach size',len(reach)); print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in region))
